label: SI cross-asset US opening-range reversal into the close (December filter) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `6A US opening-range reversal into the close (December filter)`. Session-window return predicts a later same-day session return. Filtered by signalMonth=12. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` only after strict forward PF improved from 2.41 to 2.52.
verificationSummary: Management sweep `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` strict PF 2.52 over 63 trades, beating baseline PF 2.41; train PF 1.00, bootstrap p05 1.50, block-bootstrap p05 1.31, odd/even min PF 1.06, annual pass rate 100%.
